sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday (3 October, KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last six games overall. They face a struggling Alsager Town side occupying the third-bottom position with just 4 points, having won only once in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host Dawley Town on Saturday as they pursue the leaders, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) are in-form, winning their last match, and travel to face Wednesfield Community before meeting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter enduring a concerning run of six consecutive defeats. In-form Wednesfield Community (most recent win) visit Wolverhampton Casuals before hosting Brereton Social midweek. Elsewhere, Cheadle Heath Nomads entertain Telford Town in a contest between two of the division's lowest-placed sides, Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills, and Crewe host Allscott Heath. Brereton Social (currently 14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain rooted bottom with just 2 points from 7 games.
